BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding (
    goal_code varchar(128) NOT NULL, direction_code varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    binding_revision bigint NOT NULL, course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL, binding_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    active boolean NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(goal_code,direction_code,binding_revision),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_bootstrap_binding CHECK(goal_code=lower(btrim(goal_code)) AND direction_code=lower(btrim(direction_code)) AND goal_code<>'' AND direction_code<>'' AND binding_revision>=1 AND policy_version='diagnostic-bootstrap-v1' AND binding_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND date_trunc('microseconds',created_at)=created_at)
);
COMMENT ON TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding IS 'Rollout-provisioned exact goal/direction to Course binding. Newest revision wins; active=false is a fail-closed tombstone. No seed row is supplied by this migration.';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_binding() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic bootstrap bindings are append-only'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_binding BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostic_bootstrap_binding FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_binding();

CREATE TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt (
    student_id uuid NOT NULL, idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL, request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    onboarding_version bigint NOT NULL, goal_code varchar(128) NOT NULL, direction_code varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL, binding_revision bigint NOT NULL, binding_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL, binding_created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    bootstrap_context_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL, plan_id uuid NOT NULL, plan_revision integer NOT NULL,
    plan_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL, receipt_json jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(student_id,idempotency_key), UNIQUE(plan_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_diagnostic_bootstrap_plan FOREIGN KEY(plan_id,student_id,course_id,plan_revision,plan_digest) REFERENCES diagnostic_assessment_plan(id,student_id,course_id,plan_revision,plan_digest),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt CHECK(onboarding_version>=1 AND goal_code=lower(btrim(goal_code)) AND direction_code=lower(btrim(direction_code)) AND goal_code<>'' AND direction_code<>'' AND binding_revision>=1 AND request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND binding_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND bootstrap_context_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND plan_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND date_trunc('microseconds',created_at)=created_at AND date_trunc('microseconds',binding_created_at)=binding_created_at AND jsonb_typeof(receipt_json)='object' AND (receipt_json-'student_id'-'idempotency_key'-'request_hash'-'onboarding_version'-'goal_code'-'direction_code'-'course_id'-'binding_revision'-'binding_digest'-'binding_created_at'-'bootstrap_context_digest'-'plan_id'-'plan_revision'-'plan_digest'-'created_at')='{}'::jsonb AND receipt_json->>'student_id'=student_id::text AND receipt_json->>'idempotency_key'=idempotency_key::text AND receipt_json->>'request_hash'=request_hash AND receipt_json->>'onboarding_version'=onboarding_version::text AND receipt_json->>'goal_code'=goal_code AND receipt_json->>'direction_code'=direction_code AND receipt_json->>'course_id'=course_id::text AND receipt_json->>'binding_revision'=binding_revision::text AND receipt_json->>'binding_digest'=binding_digest AND CASE WHEN receipt_json->>'binding_created_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (receipt_json->>'binding_created_at')::timestamptz=binding_created_at ELSE false END AND receipt_json->>'bootstrap_context_digest'=bootstrap_context_digest AND receipt_json->>'plan_id'=plan_id::text AND receipt_json->>'plan_revision'=plan_revision::text AND receipt_json->>'plan_digest'=plan_digest AND CASE WHEN receipt_json->>'created_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (receipt_json->>'created_at')::timestamptz=created_at ELSE false END)
);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic bootstrap receipts are immutable'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt();
COMMIT;
